source.title: Research problems on numerical ranges in quantum computing

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document ID 5585740. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/5585740 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the page was treated as blocked_or_challenged rather than as readable source text.

zbMATH API record for document ID 5585740 identified DOI 10.1080/03081080802677441 but redacted the article title and most bibliographic fields due to conflicting licenses; the API record was used only as resolver metadata.

Crossref and OpenAlex matched DOI 10.1080/03081080802677441 to the exact work titled Research problems on numerical ranges in quantum computing, published in Linear and Multilinear Algebra 57(5), pages 491-502, 2009. Crossref exposed Taylor & Francis full/PDF links, but the DOI and publisher PDF/full article endpoints returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge in the shell. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false with no best_oa_location or repository full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery inspected exact DOI/title candidates. ResearchGate confirmed the same DOI and title but stated no full text was available and only offered requesting a copy from the authors. Semantic Scholar returned openAccessPdf.status=CLOSED with an empty PDF URL. The author publication page and numericalshadow.org bibliography confirmed only citation/metadata links. Academia.edu was blocked by HTTP 403 from the shell and not accepted as readable full text. No recovered candidate exposed the full technical problem statements for extraction.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with blocked_or_challenged resolver pages. Because only metadata, abstracts, citations, blocked pages, or closed-access records were recovered, no open problems were extracted.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/5585740.json and outputs/latest.json.
